description: Emergency and helpline numbers for Musafir's demo countries. Every number is copied from the cited official page; see src/data/schema.ts for the verification levels.

entries.label: Emergency (police, fire, ambulance)
entries.notes: Single nationwide number of the Emergency Response Support System (ERSS); dispatches police, fire, health and other services.

sources.quote: The Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) is a nationwide, unified emergency response system with a single emergency number '112', for reporting and addressing all kinds of emergencies from across the country.
The Emergency Response Centre has been integrated with Police (100), Fire (101), Health (108) and Women helpline (1090) Services to provide emergency services via single emergency number - 112.

entries.label: Japan Visitor Hotline (JNTO)
entries.notes: 24 hours, every day. English, Chinese, Korean and Japanese. From outside Japan: +81-50-3816-2787.

sources.quote: JNTO Japan Visitor Hotline: 050-3816-2787 - provides emergency support for illness, disasters, and other emergencies. Available 24 hours daily, supports English, Chinese, Korean, and Japanese.

entries.label: Tokyo Metropolitan Police English helpline
entries.notes: 24 hours. Not an emergency line; dial 110 in an emergency.

sources.quote: Tokyo Metropolitan Police English Helpline: 03-3501-0110 - available 24 hours daily for English-language assistance
